Overview

Dessie is a city in Amhara with a population of 200,000. A major city in northern Ethiopia, a commercial and transportation hub in the Amhara Region. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
